comment: Part B call envelopes (docs/signal-integration/09-part-b-calls.md). decode with now = 200000. 'call' and 'callkey' mean accepted as that ephemeral kind; 'ignore' means acknowledged and dropped. The context checks (known callId, the right sender, membership, epoch order) are tested by each app, not here.

decode.name: a call id that isn't an id
a target that is neither a device id nor *
an epoch that isn't a whole number
a room key that is null
